title: Serberus — Rules (authURI sub-domain)
description: Author Serberus authorization-right (authURI) rules delivered to the com.herojoneslabs.serberus.rules.authuri sub-domain. The daemon reads every rules sub-domain and unions every com.herojoneslabs.serberus.rules[.suffix] domain. ONE configuration profile per sub-domain: two profiles cannot share a domain's single 'rules' array — macOS keeps one and silently drops the other. This form only offers the fields an authorization-right rule uses; author sudo rules in a sudo sub-domain.

policyVersion.title: Policy version
policyVersion.description: Semantic version stamped on this Jamf-authored rule set (informational; bump it when you change rules so the change is traceable).

profilePriority.title: Profile priority
profilePriority.description: Merge order of this rule set against other Serberus profiles on the device. Lower evaluates first.

rules.title: Rules
rules.description: The list of rules. Add one row per sudo command or authorization right.

id.title: Rule ID
id.description: Unique identifier within this rule set (letters, digits, dashes/underscores). Shown in logs and grants — e.g. 'prompt-jamf-recon'.

type.title: Type
type.description: 'Sudo command' matches a command run under sudo. 'Authorization right' matches a macOS AuthorizationDB right (System Settings unlock, etc.).

action.title: Action
action.description: 'Allow' lets the user unlock the authorization right with their OWN password (no Serberus prompt). 'Deny' blocks it. Deny wins over allow at equal priority.

description.title: Description
description.description: Human-readable summary shown in the Policy Builder and in prompts.

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: Evaluation order within this rule set. Lower evaluates first.

authURI.title: Authorization right (Authorization-right only)
authURI.description: For an Authorization-right rule: the AuthorizationDB right name, e.g. system.preferences.datetime. Leave blank for Sudo rules.

appTeamID.title: App Team ID (per-app rule; ignored in 0.9.0)
appTeamID.description: Ignored in Serberus 0.9.0: per-app (App Identity) rules are disabled because the app's identity comes from a value the caller can forge. A rule with this field is logged and skipped, and the right keeps its native definition. Kept so existing profiles still parse. Intended use: the 10-character Apple Team ID of the ONE app a per-app rule applies to. Requires appBundleID.

appBundleID.title: App bundle ID (per-app rule; ignored in 0.9.0)
appBundleID.description: Ignored in Serberus 0.9.0 (see appTeamID). Kept so existing profiles still parse. Intended use: the app's code-signing identifier (bundle ID), paired with appTeamID.
